column2: The  general  objects  for  which  the  Corporation  is

column1: constituted are hereby declared to be—

column2:
to 
ensure 
the 
security,  maintenance 
and
development of the Temple ;
to ensure the security of the resident Bhikkhus and
to provide their needs;
to  render  assistance  for  activities  aimed  at  the
promotion of religious, social and economic aspects
of the Temple;
while taking action for the stability of the Buddha
Dhamma, to take action for the establishment of a
society  based  on  the  Buddhist  moral  values  and
observing the five precepts;
to  make  provision  for  the  achievement  of  all
objectives expected from a Buddhist Temple;
to establish and maintain institutions for the welfare
training  and  rehabilitation  of  the  destitute,    the
disabled, the aged, the sick and displaced persons
among  Buddhists;
publish  or  cause  to  be  published  books,  journals,
magazines and other literature related to Buddhism
and establish and maintain libraries, bookshops and
printing presses.
